verdict.rationale: Supabase's regions docs say the region you choose determines where primary project data is stored, and recommend picking a specific region to meet data-residency requirements. Self-hosting with Docker gives an alternative path to full control over data location. Missing for 10: an evidenced list of available regions, clarity on whether non-primary data (backups, logs, globally distributed Edge Functions) stays in-region, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
